finding.trigger: FOI 3065/2026 — response to a request for search information relating to FOI 3156/2026 and internal review 3176/2026.
finding.disclosure_type: Search terms, repositories and consulted functions identified; Annex B retrieval email supplied outside FOIA.
finding.conduct: Q1 identifies two search terms: Great House Farm and Llandough. Q2 identifies five repositories or sources: NPCC shared drives, ChiefsNet, ACPO Archives, the NPCC Counter Terrorism Coordination Committee folder, and the Records of the Association of Chief Police Officers 1856–2005 document. Q3 identifies four consulted functions: NPCC Crime Coordination Committee, NPCC Business Support, Counter Terrorism Coordination Committee and NaCTSO. Q4: no recorded search instructions, logs, notes or file notes held; Annex B is the retrieval email supplied outside FOIA as a goodwill gesture. Q5: no separate results or conclusions held; the response explains that results are captured in emails disclosed through Q1–Q3. Q6: no recorded enquiries concerning custody, transfer, retention or disposal held. This entry describes the response only; it does not establish the underlying 1988 operation.
finding.interim_disclosure: Annex B reproduces the information-retrieval email sent to policing leads, supplied outside FOIA.
